Each output element is accumulated over k in\n// strictly increasing order (tile by tile, then within tile), matching the\n// sequential reference summation order.\n__global__ void matrixMultiplyKernel(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B,\n                                     double* __restrict__ C, const size_t N) {\n    __shared__ double As[TILE][TILE];\n    __shared__ double Bs[TILE][TILE];\n\n    const size_t tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t tid = ty * BLOCK + tx;\n    const size_t row = blockIdx.y * TILE + ty * 2;  // rows row, row+1\n    const size_t col = blockIdx.x * TILE + tx * 2;  // cols col, col+1\n\n    double s00 = 0.0, s01 = 0.0, s10 = 0.0, s11 = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < N; t0 += TILE) {\n        // Cooperative load of one TILE x TILE slab of A and B (zero-padded at edges).\n        for (size_t idx = tid; idx < TILE * TILE; idx += BLOCK * BLOCK) {\n            const size_t r = idx / TILE;\n            const size_t c = idx % TILE;\n\n            const size_t aRow = blockIdx.y * TILE + r;\n            const size_t aCol = t0 + c;\n            As[r][c] = (aRow < N && aCol < N) ? A[aRow * N + aCol] : 0.0;\n\n            const size_t bRow = t0 + r;\n            const size_t bCol = blockIdx.x * TILE + c;\n            Bs[r][c] = (bRow < N && bCol < N) ? B[bRow * N + bCol] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const size_t kMax = min(TILE, N - t0);\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < kMax; ++k) {\n            const double a0 = As[ty *  for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            \n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793061979143,"sessionID":"ses_e852e739effe2nYXERMHlEVj7A","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_0197c4uQzkZPCt1jKVADFXho","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/matmul/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)\nproject(matmul_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# Build for the GPU architecture(s) present on this machine unless overridden\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native)\nendif()\n\n# matmul.cpp contains CUDA kernels, so it is compiled by nvcc\nset_source_files_properties(matmul.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\nadd_executable(matmul matmul.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations (host code is passed through nvcc to the host compiler)\ntarget_compile_options(matmul PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-march=native,-Wall,-Wextra>)\n\n# Link math library\ntarget_link_libraries(matmul m)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/matmul/CMakeLists.txt","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/matmul/CMakeLists.txt","time":{"start":1793061979085,"end":1793061979108}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17ad28134001pG5Ha1Z1dhTw9a","sessionID":"ses_e852e739effe2nYXERMHlEVj7A","messageID":"msg_17ad278000018ZA11rIgP7OkGT"}}
